description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeReportController class as part of the OrangeHRM project. The class manages the presentation logic for generating and viewing employee reports within the HRM system, utilizing services and Vue components for the front-end rendering.

classes.name: EmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller handling the logic for employee report viewing and listing, extending AbstractVueController, and using ReportGeneratorService for report data.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Initializes and retrieves the ReportGeneratorService instance, implementing lazy loading.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the front-end component with report data if an 'id' attribute is present in the request, or defaults to a list view.
